title: The $k$-cycle shuffling with repeated cards
summary: We investigate the $k$-cycle shuffle on repeated cards, namely on a deck consisting of $l$ identical copies of each of $m$ card types, with total size $n=ml$. We establish asymptotic results for the total variation mixing of this shuffle, including cutoff and explicit limiting profiles. For fixed $l$, we show that the walk exhibits cutoff at time $\frac{n}{k}\log n$ with window of order $\frac{n}{k}$, and we identify the limiting profile in terms of the total variation distance between Poisson distributions arising from quotient fixed-point statistics.
